IMAM ALI CENTER · SPRINGFIELD, VA
النور: 32

وَ أَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَ الصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَ إِمَائِكُمْ إِنْ يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ وَ اللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Marry off those who are single among you and the upright among your male slaves and your female slaves. If they are poor, Allah will enrich them out of His grace, and Allah is all-bounteous, all-knowing.
الروم: 21

وَ مِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَ جَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

And of His signs is that He created for you mates from your own selves that you may take comfort in them, and He ordained affection and mercy between you. There are indeed signs in that for a people who reflect.

At the Imam Ali Center, we are honored to support you as you embark on one of life’s most sacred journeys: marriage (Nikah). Whether you are beginning your search, preparing for your big day, or seeking spiritual guidance, our dedicated team is here to guide you every step of the way.

MATRIMONIAL & NIKAH

Our Matrimonial & Marriage Services Include:

✦

Religious & Pre-Marital Counseling

Compassionate guidance based on Islamic values to help build a strong, loving, and enduring foundation.

☾

Nikah Services

Officiating your Islamic marriage ceremony in accordance with proper religious jurisprudence (Fiqh).

✧

Official Certification

Issuance of both religious Nikah certificates and legal marriage documentation.

⌂

Decorated Nikah Room

A beautifully curated, serene space on-site for you and your families to celebrate your special moment.
